snippet.title: Prospice: Announcement Trailer | Open Playtest Available Now
snippet.description:
Join the Open Playtest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4067370/Prospice/ 
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/9YHwRKDJnn 

Venture beyond the end of the road in Prospice, a survival logistics and exploration game set on a forbidden island warped by the remains of dead gods.

Plan routes, manage fuel and cargo, upgrade your truck, explore on foot, and uncover artifacts and secrets buried deep within a corrupted land.

Wishlist Prospice on Steam and prepare for the expedition.
